title: Pen and paper gal converted
body:
I’ve always been a stickler for reaching for a pen; because I like writing but also due to a hoarding problem of nice scraps of paper I feel I should make use of.

Notes has changed all that. It’s so quick and easy, and it really helps me progress organising my thoughts and plans since I have everything in one place.

It’s also inadvertently helped me clear away the paper clutter at home but you’ll never stop my pen collecting; now I hoard those for birthday cards, drawing, and journal keeping. Which I have a lot more time for now, thanks to Notes.
author: likeawhale

title: Simply bad.
body: The app 'Notes' is quite basic and lacks many features. The biggest drawback is the absence of a clipboard function to store up to 40 copies for pasting, second only to how poorly it handles text editing on Apple iOS. I mainly use this app for grocery lists and short notes because of its limitations. I am aware of the 'Freeform' app, which I have not yet fully explored.
author: Viggi the Wacko.

author: The black pilgrim

title: The page keeps going up and down
body:
Every time I type a letter the page scrolls up and when I type the next letter, the page goes down again. 

So when I’m typing something the page yo-yos up and down
